//: PRODUCTION configuration for the Main API. docker-compose.yml mounts this over /app/appsettings.json, and the image build deletes the published one - so this file is the COMPLETE runtime configuration, not an overlay. Keys prefixed with // are documentation; the .NET configuration binder ignores them. Prefer environment variables for secrets: ASP.NET Core maps __ to :, e.g. ConnectionStrings__MainDbConnection.
//AuthService: Server-to-server call for session validation, so it uses the container name on the compose network rather than the public URL.
//Application: Regional defaults shipped with the template. Change these for your own project: TimeZone accepts an IANA id ('Asia/Singapore', 'Europe/London') or a Windows id ('Singapore Standard Time'); Locale and Currency drive number/date/money formatting.
//Sentry: Leave Dsn empty to keep error reporting switched off.
//OneSignal: Web push. Empty credentials mean notifications are simply not delivered.
//AllowedCORSOrigin: ORIGINS ONLY - scheme + host + optional port, no path. Replace YOUR_DOMAIN with the public origin the browser loads, e.g. https://apps.example.com. A path such as https://apps.example.com/myapp/api-main is a URL, not an origin, and will never match.
//FileStorage: BasePath matches the ./uploads bind mount in docker-compose.yml. Switch Provider to 'S3' and fill in the S3 block to store files in object storage instead.
//AzureOpenAI: Powers the optional AI chat feature. Empty Endpoint/ApiKey means the chat endpoints report that AI is not configured.
//EmailSettings: Defaults point at the Mailpit container in docker-compose.yml (SMTP on apptemplate-mailpit:1025, web inbox on http://127.0.0.1:8025). Swap SmtpHost/SmtpPort for a real relay and turn EnableSsl on. SenderEmail is required - the email service throws if it is blank.
